blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Information and Communications Technology Secretary Henry Rhoel Aguda has resigned and Malacañang had “already accepted” his resignation, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said on Saturday. There was no immediate confirmation from Malacañang. Palace insiders said that President Marcos himself would speak about this matter on Sunday before flying back from Singapore, where he […]...
